constraint_support.equation_template: one shared slot, fixed outer parameters; native coefficient-family search in the full strict-real composition against original y; nested slots, outer free parameters and mapped coordinates rejected
constraint_support.operators: native polynomial/rational family with explicitly configured ordinary torch functions; exports post-filtered
constraint_support.functions_and_denominators: ordinary functions installed through public extend_function_dict during fit/reconstruction; upstream protected defaults are not relabelled ordinary
constraint_support.units: unknown fitted coefficient units; portable post-filter
constraint_support.max_nodes: source AST family-size filtering before coefficient fit; extends Complete/Max with missing lower-degree families, preserves original order/repetitions and fixed No mode, rejects an empty feasible set; active-parameter count remains a stopping preference
constraint_support.variables: disallowed columns excluded before native search; full-schema export/prediction checked
constraint_support.allowed_variables: native input-column subset with original IDs; no constant-only or mapped-input/template subset fallback
constraint_support.probes: declared-point finite predictions required during coefficient search and native family/reduction selection; post-filter only in explicit filter mode
constraint_support.response_bounds: explicit SLSQP inequalities/equalities in native coefficient fitting and pruning refits; strict feasibility in native family/reduction selection; declared points only
constraint_support.response_checks: finite-step response inequalities/equalities passed to SLSQP coefficient fitting and pruning refits; strict feasibility in native family/reduction selection; no global guarantee

response_search.solver_outcome_scope: solver_outcomes denominator is optimizer_result_count, not constrained_solves. constrained_solves counts coefficient-solving requests; one request can yield a primary result plus retry. basinhopping counts its best-local result only, not every internal solve. feasible_returns uses constrained_solves denominator; none establishes per-output candidate convergence
response_search.scope: declared finite probe/response points; independent final verification required

operator_policy: unavailable_search_operators is the requested/export-capability difference, not decoder reachability; generation enforcement and context-dependent routes are specified by constraint_support and native metadata

candidate_pool.archive_scope: all faithfully exported native candidates, not all internal search states
candidate_pool.quality_scope: Train/shared probes only when explicit bounded allocation is requested; compare owns final eligibility

truncation: none; all faithfully emitted candidates reach common evaluation

requirements_ref.scope: canonical common request; native settings/checks are derived evidence

response_enforcement.stage: native family coefficient optimization and selection

capability_declaration.family_search: fixed keeps one configured family; up_to searches bounded degree families. Default polynomial=fixed, rational=up_to; Complete includes lower-degree extension

constraints.equation_template: one shared slot, fixed outer parameters; native coefficient-family search in the full strict-real composition against original y; nested slots, outer free parameters and mapped coordinates rejected
constraints.operators: native polynomial/rational family with explicitly configured ordinary torch functions; exports post-filtered
constraints.functions_and_denominators: ordinary functions installed through public extend_function_dict during fit/reconstruction; upstream protected defaults are not relabelled ordinary
constraints.units: unknown fitted coefficient units; portable post-filter
constraints.max_nodes: source AST family-size filtering before coefficient fit; extends Complete/Max with missing lower-degree families, preserves original order/repetitions and fixed No mode, rejects an empty feasible set; active-parameter count remains a stopping preference
constraints.variables: disallowed columns excluded before native search; full-schema export/prediction checked
constraints.allowed_variables: native input-column subset with original IDs; no constant-only or mapped-input/template subset fallback
constraints.probes: declared-point finite predictions required during coefficient search and native family/reduction selection; post-filter only in explicit filter mode
constraints.response_bounds: explicit SLSQP inequalities/equalities in native coefficient fitting and pruning refits; strict feasibility in native family/reduction selection; declared points only
constraints.response_checks: finite-step response inequalities/equalities passed to SLSQP coefficient fitting and pruning refits; strict feasibility in native family/reduction selection; no global guarantee

constraint_application.operators: native polynomial/rational family with explicitly configured ordinary torch functions; exports post-filtered
constraint_application.max_nodes: source AST family-size filtering before coefficient fit; extends Complete/Max with missing lower-degree families, preserves original order/repetitions and fixed No mode, rejects an empty feasible set; active-parameter count remains a stopping preference
